title: GPU profile hypothesis record
description: Ranked, evidenced output of a performance-mode analysis. The record lives in the working directory beside the profile it describes, never in the handbook: it is an observation about one run. Array order is the ranking.

identity.description: How to find this capture again, in terms meaningful in the working directory.

build.description: What produced the capture. A suggestion is actionable only if the change it names exists in this build.

capability_gaps.description: What the capture cannot observe. Absent instrumentation supports no hypothesis about the absent subsystem and no claim that it is healthy.

derived_by_hand.description: Quantities not produced by the tool. Empty is the expected state.

hypotheses.description: Ranked most significant first. The ranking is part of the answer.

bottleneck.description: Short name for the pathology. Deliberately not a fixed enum; see the playbook.

evidence.description: Every figure must be one the extraction emitted.

from.description: Subcommand or query index that produced it.

queries.description: The commands run, so the analysis can be re-derived rather than re-trusted. Never empty: a hypothesis whose figures name no command is not re-derivable, and an empty list silently disabled the provenance check until 2026-09-14.

runtime_fraction_pct.description: Share of the phase's elapsed time. Null when not computable; never guessed.

speedup_bounds_pct.description: Computed from runtime_fraction_pct, never asserted. Null when the fraction is null or leaves no residual runtime.

change_class.description: If the change alters what is computed it is algorithm; if only how, it is lower.

leaves.description: Required when basis names a leaf. A cited leaf is checkable; recall is not.

refuted_by.description: What observation would overturn this. A hypothesis with no refutation is not one.
